title: GEAS 10-02 Mastery Challenge: Board Structure, Powers & Categories of Practice
description: Comprehensive 25-item decoupled board examination challenge covering PRB-ECE composition, qualifications, quasi-judicial powers, and the 3 professional practice tiers under R.A. 9292.

questions.promptText: Who appoints the Chairman and Members of the Professional Regulatory Board of Electronics Engineering?
questions.choiceA: The President of the Philippines
questions.choiceB: The Chairman of the Professional Regulation Commission
questions.choiceD: The Secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology
questions.explanation: Section 6 mandates that the Chairman and two Members of the Board are appointed by the President of the Philippines.

questions.promptText: How many nominees per position does the Accredited Professional Organization (IECEP) submit to the PRC for a Board vacancy?
questions.choiceA: Five (5) nominees
questions.choiceD: Ten (10) nominees
questions.explanation: Section 6 states that the APO submits five (5) nominees per position to the Commission.

questions.promptText: From the list of nominees submitted by the APO, how many recommendees does the PRC rank and submit to the President of the Philippines?
questions.choiceA: Three (3) recommendees
questions.choiceD: Four (4) recommendees
questions.explanation: Section 6 states that the Commission chooses and ranks three (3) recommendees per position for the President's selection.

questions.promptText: To qualify as a Member of the Board of ECE, a person must have been a citizen and resident of the Philippines for at least how many consecutive years prior to appointment?
questions.choiceA: Five (5) consecutive years
questions.choiceD: Seven (7) consecutive years
questions.explanation: Section 8(a) requires a Board member to be a citizen and resident of the Philippines for at least five (5) consecutive years prior to appointment.

questions.promptText: Which professional registration grade must an individual hold to be eligible for appointment to the Board of ECE?
questions.choiceA: Professional Electronics Engineer (PECE)
questions.choiceD: Consulting Telecommunications Engineer (CTE)
questions.explanation: Section 8(c) specifies that a Board member must be a holder of a valid Certificate of Registration and Professional ID as a PECE.

questions.promptText: What is the minimum required period of active practice in the electronics engineering profession for a prospective Board member?
questions.choiceA: At least ten (10) years
questions.choiceD: At least fifteen (15) years
questions.explanation: Section 8(e) requires at least ten (10) years of active professional practice prior to appointment.

questions.promptText: What must a Board nominee do if they are currently teaching in an engineering university or associated with a board review center?
questions.choiceA: Officially resign from teaching and all review center activities prior to taking the oath of office
questions.choiceB: Take a temporary leave of absence during exam months only
questions.choiceC: Transfer their review classes to an online platform
questions.choiceD: Disclose their ownership shares but continue lecturing
questions.explanation: Section 8(f) requires that a nominee must not be a faculty member or have pecuniary interest in any school or review center, and must resign prior to taking oath.

questions.promptText: What is the regular term of office of the Chairman and Members of the Board of ECE?
questions.choiceA: Three (3) years
questions.choiceD: Five (5) years
questions.explanation: Section 9 mandates a regular term of office of three (3) years.

questions.promptText: What is the maximum total continuous tenure permitted for a member of the Board of ECE through reappointment?
questions.choiceA: Six (6) years
questions.choiceD: Five (5) years
questions.explanation: Section 9 states that a member may be reappointed, provided that the total continuous tenure does not exceed six (6) years (i.e. two 3-year terms).

questions.promptText: If a vacancy occurs in the Board due to resignation before the term ends, how long does the replacement member serve?
questions.choiceA: For the unexpired portion of the term only
questions.choiceB: A fresh full term of 3 years
questions.choiceC: Until the end of the calendar year
questions.choiceD: For 6 years automatically
questions.explanation: Section 9 explicitly states: 'Any vacancy occurring within the term of a member shall be filled for the unexpired portion of the term only.'

questions.promptText: Within how many days may a decision or resolution of the Board of ECE be appealed to the Professional Regulation Commission?
questions.choiceA: Within fifteen (15) days from receipt of the decision
questions.choiceD: Within sixty (60) days from receipt
questions.explanation: Section 7 states that decisions and resolutions of the Board are appealable to the Commission within fifteen (15) days from receipt.

questions.promptText: Which legal writ can the Board of ECE issue to compel the attendance of witnesses in administrative investigations?
questions.choiceA: Subpoena ad testificandum
questions.choiceD: Writ of mandamus
questions.explanation: Section 7 empowers the Board to issue *subpoena ad testificandum* to compel attendance of witnesses (and *subpoena duces tecum* for documents).

questions.promptText: Which legal writ can the Board of ECE issue to compel the production of books, papers, and documents?
questions.choiceA: Subpoena duces tecum
questions.choiceD: Writ of injunction
questions.explanation: *Subpoena duces tecum* commands the production of books, documents, and physical records.

questions.promptText: Under Section 12, who acts as the custodian of all official records of the Board of ECE?
questions.choiceA: The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC)
questions.choiceB: The National Archives of the Philippines
questions.choiceC: The Institute of Electronics Engineers of the Philippines (IECEP)
questions.choiceD: The Department of Science and Technology (DOST)
questions.explanation: Section 12 provides that all records of the Board, including examination papers and minutes, shall be kept by the Commission.

questions.promptText: What are the three (3) distinct categories of practice recognized under Section 4 of R.A. 9292?
questions.choiceA: Professional Electronics Engineer, Electronics Engineer, and Electronics Technician
questions.choiceB: Electronics Engineer, Telecommunications Engineer, and Computer Engineer
questions.choiceC: Master Electronics Engineer, Senior Engineer, and Apprentice
questions.choiceD: Chief Engineer, Broadcast Engineer, and Radio Technician
questions.explanation: Section 4 establishes: (a) Professional Electronics Engineer (PECE), (b) Electronics Engineer (ECE), and (c) Electronics Technician (ECT).

questions.promptText: Which of the following professional activities is exclusively restricted to a licensed PECE under Section 5?
questions.choiceA: Sole authority to sign and seal electronics plans, specifications, and reports
questions.choiceB: Supervision of electronics equipment assembly lines
questions.choiceC: Teaching of undergraduate electronics engineering courses
questions.choiceD: Testing and calibration of laboratory instruments
questions.explanation: Section 5(a) explicitly grants the sole authority to sign and seal plans, specs, schematics, and design documents exclusively to PECEs.

questions.promptText: Can an Electronics Engineer (ECE) legally offer independent 'Consulting Services' on electronics engineering projects under R.A. 9292?
questions.choiceA: No, consulting services in electronics engineering are restricted to licensed PECEs
questions.choiceB: Yes, any ECE with at least 1 year of experience can offer consulting services
questions.choiceC: Yes, provided they pay an additional business tax to the local government
questions.choiceD: Yes, provided they pass a special foreign language examination
questions.explanation: Section 5(a) reserves independent consulting services exclusively to Professional Electronics Engineers (PECE).

questions.promptText: Which category of practice is defined as performing 'non-engineering technical work' relating to installation, maintenance, testing, and operation?
questions.choiceA: Electronics Technician (ECT)
questions.choiceD: Electrical Safety Officer
questions.explanation: Section 5(b) defines ECT as performing non-engineering technical work such as installation, operation, maintenance, testing, and sales.

questions.promptText: What is the minimum educational qualification to be eligible to take the Electronics Technician (ECT) Licensure Examination?
questions.choiceA: Graduate of a 2-year technician/vocational course, or at least 3rd year equivalent of BSECE
questions.choiceB: High school graduate with 1 month of computer gaming experience
questions.choiceC: Holder of a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering
questions.choiceD: Completion of primary elementary school education only
questions.explanation: Section 14(b) requires a graduate of an Associate, technician, trade or vocational course in electronics, or completion of at least 3rd year equivalent of BSECE.

questions.promptText: What is the minimum educational requirement to take the Electronics Engineer (ECE) Licensure Examination?
questions.choiceA: Graduate of a Bachelor of Science in Electronics and Communications Engineering or Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering
questions.choiceC: Graduate of a 2-year technical diploma in electronics
questions.choiceD: Master of Science in Information Technology
questions.explanation: Section 14(a) specifies a graduate of BSECE/BSEcE from an institution recognized by the government (CHED).

questions.promptText: To upgrade registration from ECE to Professional Electronics Engineer (PECE), how many years of active practice are required?
questions.choiceA: At least seven (7) years, including at least two (2) years of significant engineering work
questions.choiceB: At least three (3) years of teaching experience
questions.choiceC: At least ten (10) years of general employment
questions.choiceD: At least five (5) years of retail equipment sales
questions.explanation: Section 18 requires at least seven (7) years of active practice, of which at least two (2) years must be in significant engineering work.

questions.promptText: How many PECE certifications attesting to the factual accuracy of the applicant's experience are required for PECE registration?
questions.choiceA: Three (3) certifications from three (3) licensed PECEs
questions.choiceB: Five (5) certifications from any registered engineers
questions.choiceC: One (1) certification from a barangay chairman
questions.choiceD: Two (2) certifications from company HR officers
questions.explanation: Section 18 requires three (3) certifications signed by three (3) licensed PECEs stating that the submitted experience is factual.

questions.promptText: What additional evaluation process must an applicant undergo to obtain the PECE license after submitting documents?
questions.choiceA: Pass an en banc oral interview/verification conducted by the Board of ECE
questions.choiceD: Publish three textbooks in an international IEEE journal
questions.explanation: Section 18 requires passing the en banc oral interview conducted by the Board.

questions.promptText: Who has the authority to suspend or remove a member of the Board of ECE for neglect of duty, incompetence, or exam rigging?
questions.choiceA: The President of the Philippines, upon recommendation of the PRC
questions.choiceB: The President of the IECEP National Board
questions.choiceD: The Senate Committee on Civil Service
questions.explanation: Section 11 states that the President of the Philippines, upon recommendation of the Commission, may suspend or remove any Board member.

questions.promptText: Under Section 22, taking the professional oath is:
questions.choiceA: A mandatory prerequisite prior to entering the practice of PECE, ECE, or ECT
questions.choiceB: An optional ceremony that can be waived upon paying a ₱500 fee
questions.choiceC: Required only for engineers working in government agencies
questions.choiceD: Required only for engineers residing in Metro Manila
questions.explanation: Section 22 mandates that all successful examinees and registered professionals must take a professional oath before the Board or authorized officer prior to practice.
